    Element Description
    com.im.njams.sdk.common.ResourceLoader
    Load resources directly instead, e.g. with ClassLoader.getResourceAsStream(String). For providing images to the SDK, use an ImageSupplier implementation, such as ResourceImageSupplier, FileImageSupplier, URLImageSupplier, StreamImageSupplier or DirectImageSupplier. Note that this class does not return a resource's original bytes, see ResourceLoader.getResourceBinary(String).

    See ResourceLoader.
    com.im.njams.sdk.configuration.ProcessConfiguration.isExclude()
    Replaced by Configuration.hasProcessExcludeFilter(Path)
    com.im.njams.sdk.configuration.ProcessConfiguration.setExclude​(Boolean)
    Replaced by Configuration.setProcessExcluded(Path, boolean)
    com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage.DataMasking
    Masking is scoped to the Njams instance since 6.1.0: use the masker returned by njams.configuration().dataMasking() (DataMasker). Patterns registered here still apply to every instance in the JVM until this class is removed. The SDK no longer registers the patterns from settings or configuration here, so DataMasking.maskString(String) and DataMasking.getPatterns() only cover patterns registered through this class.
    com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage.DataMasking.addPattern​(String)
    See DataMasking; use DataMasker.addPattern(String).
    com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage.DataMasking.addPatterns​(List<String>)
    See DataMasking; use DataMasker.addPatterns(List).
    com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage.DataMasking.getPatterns()
    See DataMasking; use DataMasker.getPatterns().
    com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage.DataMasking.maskString​(String)
    See DataMasking; use DataMasker.maskString(String).
    com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage.DataMasking.removePatterns()
    See DataMasking; use DataMasker.removePatterns().
    com.im.njams.sdk.model.layout.SimpleProcessModelLayouter
    Use CommonBfsModelLayouter instead. CommonBfsModelLayouter supports parallel branches, convergence, and nested groups correctly, and is the default layouter used by Njams since 6.0.
  • Interfaces 
    Interface Description
    com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.factory.JmsFactory
    Since 6.1.0 in favour of the jakarta.jms based SPI interface JmsFactory. This javax.jms interface stays supported and is not scheduled for removal. It can also never be relocated: third-party implementations ship a META-INF/services/com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.factory.JmsFactory file, which ServiceLoader resolves by this exact type name, so renaming or moving the type would make those implementations disappear without any error.
  • Classes 
    Class Description
    com.im.njams.sdk.common.ResourceLoader
    Load resources directly instead, e.g. with ClassLoader.getResourceAsStream(String). For providing images to the SDK, use an ImageSupplier implementation, such as ResourceImageSupplier, FileImageSupplier, URLImageSupplier, StreamImageSupplier or DirectImageSupplier. Note that this class does not return a resource's original bytes, see ResourceLoader.getResourceBinary(String).
    com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.javax.factory.ActiveMqSslJmsFactory
    Since 6.1.0 in favour of the jakarta.jms based ActiveMqSslJmsFactory. This javax.jms implementation stays supported and is not scheduled for removal.

    Since 6.1.0 in favour of the jakarta.jms based AzureServiceBusJmsFactory. This javax.jms implementation stays supported and is not scheduled for removal.
    com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.javax.factory.JndiJmsFactory
    Since 6.1.0 in favour of the jakarta.jms based JndiJmsFactory. This javax.jms implementation stays supported and is not scheduled for removal.
    com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.javax.JmsReceiver
    Since 6.1.0 in favour of the jakarta.jms based receiver JmsReceiver. This javax.jms implementation stays supported and is not scheduled for removal.
    com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.javax.JmsSender
    Since 6.1.0 in favour of the jakarta.jms based sender JmsSender. This javax.jms implementation stays supported and is not scheduled for removal.
    com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.javax.SharedJmsReceiver
    Since 6.1.0 in favour of the jakarta.jms based shared receiver SharedJmsReceiver. This javax.jms implementation stays supported and is not scheduled for removal.
    com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage.DataMasking
    Masking is scoped to the Njams instance since 6.1.0: use the masker returned by njams.configuration().dataMasking() (DataMasker). Patterns registered here still apply to every instance in the JVM until this class is removed. The SDK no longer registers the patterns from settings or configuration here, so DataMasking.maskString(String) and DataMasking.getPatterns() only cover patterns registered through this class.
    com.im.njams.sdk.model.layout.SimpleProcessModelLayouter
    Use CommonBfsModelLayouter instead. CommonBfsModelLayouter supports parallel branches, convergence, and nested groups correctly, and is the default layouter used by Njams since 6.0.
